thread:
maria: heads up: dependency alert -> glibc resolver overflow CVE-2026-0420 found in redwood/base:2026-03 (glibc 2.35). severity HIGH. tagging eng-runtime + eng-infra + sec-oncall. we need rebuild, sign, and a short rollout plan.
jonathan: thanks. exploitability? remote or local only?
maria: reproducer shows RCE with crafted resolver lookup + writable mount + relaxed seccomp. so remote-ish but needs some conditions. still critical.
sam: quick mitigations: 1) tighten seccomp profiles to deny the offending syscalls, 2) revoke CAP_SYS_ADMIN from non-priv pods, 3) deploy an image admission check in prod to require attestation. I'll prep the staging seccomp and webhook patch.
lee: @sam apply to staging runners now, leave me oncall for the window in case rollback needed.
sam: applied seccomp patch to staging via: kubectl patch daemonset runner-canary -n infra --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io~1pod","value":"runtime/default"}]'
deploy-bot: CI pipeline 119998 started for redwood/base:rebuild-5198765432 (job 11001)
anya: signing/provenance note: we must restrict cosign-sign permissions. propose new RoleBinding so only keystore-ci SA can call KMS-asymmetricSign for cosign key. RBAC snippet: ```yaml
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: registry-cosign-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
jonathan: CI uses gcpkms key: gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/rebuild-signer. who currently has iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the signer SA? need to narrow to ci-signer-sa only.
maria: current list: ci-signer-sa, infra-deploy-sa, legacy-release-sa. plan: remove infra-deploy-sa and legacy-release-sa, grant short-lived token creation to k8s-keystore agent only. will open INFRA-4301 for change request.
sec-oncall: approved change window tonight 01:30-02:30 UTC for RBAC rotation + key rotate. ensure ticket INFRA-4301 is created with rollback plan.
jonathan: audit logging: we need KMS AsymmetricSign entries and cosign attest events in SIEM. suggested logging filter: protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"ci-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com". forward to ops-audit-kafka. include image digest & job id in transformed payload.
anya: added sink to ops-siem and mapping. sample event: {"ts":"2026-03-23T01:35:10Z","actor":"ci-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","action":"AsymmetricSign","image":"redwood/base@sha256:ef1a2b3c","pipeline":"11001"}
maria: timeline proposal:
- T+0.5h: staging seccomp & CAP removal verified (sam/lee)
- T+1.5h: build base with glibc 2.37 + full CI smoke/regressions
- T+2h: cosign sign using rotated key (CI) + push SBOM & attestation
- T+3h: canary deploy to two clusters with admission webhook enforcing attestation
- T+6h: progressive rollout if green
sam: I'll prepare admission webhook PR to block images lacking cosign attestation in prod. will include a fast feature-flag and rollback toggle.
lee: I'll schedule oncall coverage for the window and standby for immediate rollback. also will coordinate a short freeze for external deploys during T+2->T+4.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline 11001 finished: build succeeded, image redwood/base@sha256:ef1a2b3c, scans: glibc 2.37 (patched) -> no HIGH vulns detected. attestations produced.
oncall-note: after rollout, run quick forensics: list deployed images with glibc<=2.35 via registry query + gcloud container images list-tags, notify affected namespaces and customers if any public exposure.
maria: assigning follow-ups: sam -> webhook PR, anya -> SIEM sink tests + transformation, jonathan -> CI signer IAM delta PR, lee -> oncall rota + deploy freeze note. I'll create INFRA-4301 and link this thread. closing once tickets open. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
